summary: Verdict uses strict raw-band comparisons and wrong labels instead of the inclusive 2.5/97.5 perm-pct lattice.
P2/P4 retries can skip failed gate artifacts and continue as if the validity gate passed.
Output-affecting fit/stat/upload flags are absent from the resume manifest.
P2/P4/P5/P6 validate producer schemas only after heavy model or fit work begins.
Capture, pass-b, and dense-L20 external bundles lack pre-consumption key-set checks.
Both arms evaluate every alive feature instead of the registered seeded 16,384-feature panel.
NaN arm-b FVE is classified PASS because demotion tests only fve < floor.
Headline retrieval uses full float64 NumPy distance matrices rather than the planned chunked GPU path.
The 1,920-chunk stream persists only every 50 chunks and omits stable chunk names in progress logs.
New HF artifact paths reach torch.load(weights_only=False) without immutable digest protection.
P3 omits the arm-c split_indices.npz from its uploaded split-meta bundle.
Required K=20 nulls are absent for identity+bias and registered companion R2 reads.
Hero figures call the blog-default style instead of set_paper_style("iclr").
